values.name: Drop charge
values.description: Fee charged when a rental is terminated in a city or location other than where the rental originated.

values.name: Extra day
values.description: The associated charge is for each day beyond the indicated base period.

values.name: Extra week
values.description: The associated charge is for each week beyond the indicated base period.

values.name: Extra hour
values.description: The associated charge is for each hour beyond the indicated base period.

values.name: Extra month
values.description: The associated charge is for each month beyond the indicated base period.

values.name: Per mile
values.description: The associated charge is for each mile the service is in use.

values.name: Per kilometer
values.description: The associated charge is for each kilometer the service is in use.

values.name: Free miles
values.description: To indicate there is no charge for the specified number of free miles.

values.name: Free kilometers
values.description: To indicate there is no charge for the specified number of free kilometers.
